 BOISE, Idaho (CBS2) — The grandfather of one of the Idaho 'doomsday' victims is reacting to Lori Vallow's attempt to overturn her murder convictions.
 Lori Vallow is the mother who was convicted in 2023 in the deaths of her children, J.J. Vallow, Tylee Ryan and her husband's first wife, Tammy Daybell. Vallow and her husband, Chad Daybell, claimed that evil spirits possessed her victims.
 J.J. Vallow's grandfather, Larry Woodcock, says he is not surprised about Lori Vallow's attempt at a new trial.
 "I am absolutely not surprised one bit. She is, uh, uh, egotistical. She's, she's every word that you can probably think about, for a person like herself. And does it surprise me? No. But she better be careful what she asks for because there are worse thing in in life than being in prison in Idaho, I can well assure you that," Larry Woodcock says.
 Larry Woodcock also shared some of his most cherished memories with J.J. and his brother-in-law Charles.
 Lori Vallow was also found guilty of conspiring to commit murder.
